memoryRule: a held look is geometry-neutral; leaving causes a remote witness to become missing, another to inherit a false reconstruction, and a fourth to remember the edge
interactionRule: pointer or touch holds near a witness and releases; Enter, Space, and the look control use deterministic looks; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: pressure misprint, browser-native accordion, and single pressure plate -> one p5.js Canvas 2D witness cutout field with produced absences
compositionRupture: distributed stamps, crooked page, and singular plate -> one off-axis aperture surrounded by uneven planar cut-outs and remote cavities
encounterRupture: three-mark chord, scroll turn, and bounded pressure stroke -> situated hold-and-leave gesture whose answer is displaced from the visitor
temporalRupture: material misallocation, false pagination, and pressure inference -> departure memory in which the field forgets the watched place and invents the wrong one
mediumRupture: p5.js raster print, browser DOM/CSS page, and pressure plate -> p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D cut-out field rendered from state geometry
changedRule: A held look does not move the approached form. Leaving it makes a remote witness disappear, makes another inherit a false reconstruction, and gives a fourth edge the memory.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one cut-out field with an off-axis dark aperture. A valid look-and-leave changes actual remote geometry: a cavity opens, a false edge shifts elsewhere, and a remembering edge persists across four events.
falsifier: Delete if the approached witness is the answer, if a short press commits, if remote absence is cosmetic, if the field reads as a generic crowd or diagram, if later looks reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v038 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the witness-absence field from the last three naive grammars, or if absence is not materially produced.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
